name: Smart Popup by Supsystic
author: supsystic

sections.description:
Turn More Visitors into Leads — or Simply Keep Them Informed

Most visitors leave without taking action.
Some should subscribe.
Some should buy.
Some just need important information.

The message matters.
But timing and relevance matter more.

Smart Popup helps you show the right message at the right moment — using exit intent, scroll triggers, and detailed targeting controls — so you can grow your email list, increase conversions, or share updates without frustrating your visitors.

Because success with popups isn’t about showing more.
It’s about showing smarter.

With precise controls, you decide:

  • When your popup appears
  • Where it appears
  • Who sees it
  • On which device
  • Under what conditions

That’s how you capture attention — without damaging user experience.
Start free. Upgrade anytime as your needs grow.

Precise Targeting & Display Control
Relevance increases conversions — and reduces annoyance.

  • Page-level targeting
  • Post & category targeting
  • Device targeting (desktop or mobile)
  • User role targeting
  • Referrer-based targeting
  • Scheduled display rules

Show offers or announcements only where they make sense.

Smart Timing & Behaviour Triggers

Appear when visitors are ready — not randomly.

  • Exit intent detection
  • Scroll percentage triggers
  • Time delay triggers
  • Click-trigger popups
  • Inactivity triggers

Timing is the difference between helpful and intrusive.

Lead Capture & Communication
Turn traffic into subscribers — or keep visitors informed.

  • Customisable form fields
  • WooCommerce offer popups
  • Announcement & notification popups
  • Event notifications and webinar reminders
  • Fully responsive designs

Email marketing integrations are available in the Pro version.
Respect user privacy with optional controlled display frequency and GDPR-friendly options.

Works With Your Favorite Tools

Smart Popup integrates with the tools you already use.
Connect directly with popular email services such as MailChimp, Aweber, ActiveCampaign, Jetpack, MailPoet, Constant Contact, and more. Simply enter your API key, choose your list, and start collecting subscribers immediately.

No rebuilding. No complex setup.

Practical Use Cases
Smart Popup isn’t just for marketers.

  • Grow your email list
  • Promote limited-time offers
  • Display holiday hours or service updates
  • Show maintenance notices
  • Highlight WooCommerce promotions
  • Announce policy or pricing changes
  • Event notifications and webinar reminders
  • Promote ticket releases
  • Countdown-based campaign popups

Because sometimes you’re converting.
And sometimes you’re simply communicating.

Flexible Design & Customisation
Create popups that match your brand.

  • Ready-to-use templates
  • Custom styling controls
  • Animation settings
  • Overlay & background options
  • Responsive preview mode

No coding required.

Lightweight & Performance-Friendly
Built to run efficiently.

  • Optimised scripts
  • Mobile-ready
  • Compatible with modern themes
  • Clean integration

Because conversions shouldn’t slow your site down.

Built-In Performance Insights

See what works — and improve what doesn’t.
Smart Popup tracks impressions and user interactions so you can refine your messaging, timing, and targeting over time.

Smarter popups aren’t just shown.
They’re measured.

A/B Testing (Pro)

Test different versions of your popups to see what performs best.
Compare views, interactions, and conversions to optimise design, messaging, and timing based on real visitor behaviour.

Free vs Pro

Free Version Includes:

  • Popup builder
  • Core timing & trigger options
  • Basic targeting rules
  • Custom design controls
  • Responsive display

Pro Version Unlocks:

  • Advanced targeting rules
  • Email marketing integrations
  • Additional trigger types
  • Extended template library
  • A/B testing
  • Priority support

Upgrade anytime when you need more control.
sections.faq:
Will this slow down my website?

Smart Popup is built to run efficiently. Proper configuration ensures minimal performance impact.

Is exit intent supported?

Yes. Exit intent detection allows you to present offers just before a visitor leaves your site (Desktop only).

Can I control where popups appear?

Yes. You can target specific pages, posts, categories, devices, and more.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes. Popups are fully responsive and can be controlled separately for mobile and desktop.

Can I connect it to my email marketing service?

Email marketing integrations are available in the Pro version.
